prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Charlotte. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Charlotte for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
I can definitely help — I just need one quick detail so I give you accurate, local names: what ZIP code or neighborhood in Charlotte are you in (or will you travel anywhere in the city)? Also tell me whether this is for an adult or a child/teen and whether you use dental insurance (or have a budget preference). 

While you reply, here’s how I’ll pick the specific orthodontists to call and what I recommend you ask each one (so you get the best option for braces or Invisalign):

How I’ll choose providers for you
- Proximity: practices within a reasonable drive of your ZIP.
- Experience with Invisalign: I’ll prioritize providers with high-level Invisalign status (Platinum/Diamond) — that correlates with lots of Invisalign cases.
- Credentials: orthodontists (DDS/DMD with orthodontic residency); American Board of Orthodontics certification when available.
- Technology & comfort: practices that use digital scanning (iTero), 3D imaging, and offer clear braces options and retention plans.
- Reputation: recent patient reviews, before/after photos, and whether they offer free or low-cost consultations.
- Access & affordability: clinics that clearly state payment plans, insurance acceptance, and emergency availability.

Specific questions to ask on the phone or at consultation
- Do you treat adults/teens/children? Do you do Invisalign and how many Invisalign cases have you done?
- What is your Invisalign status (e.g., Platinum/Diamond)? If they don’t know, ask how many Invisalign cases per year.
- Do you use digital impressions (scanner) or traditional molds?
- What are my full treatment options for my case (metal braces, ceramic, Invisalign, lingual)?
- Estimated treatment time and total cost (including retainers) and insurance/payment plan options.
- Do you provide before/after photos of similar cases? Can I see patient reviews?
- Who handles orthodontic emergencies and how are they handled after hours?

Red flags to watch for
- No consultations or inability to show before/after cases.
- Providers who promise a fixed time or cost before an exam (every mouth is different).
- No clear payment/insurance information or poor communication.

If you give me your ZIP and whether this is for an adult or child, I’ll return a short, prioritized list of 3–5 specific orthodontists in Charlotte (with why I picked each) so you’ll know exactly who to call.
